counterfactual.change: Reduced body 1 initial vy from 57.83 to 5.0 only; removes high-speed grazing impact and energy stays ~1273 J with no violation.

explanation: High-speed grazing circle-circle collision injects energy: bodies are separated at step 25 with normal energy ~2933 J, then at step 26 a single touching contact (gap -0.001) produces huge spurious tangential velocities (body0 vx -36.7 vy -36.25, body1 vx 3.6 vy -55.2) raising energy to 19061 J. Likely collision impulse uses wrong contact normal / over-correction for oblique heavy-light (12.6:1, e=0.5 vs 1) impact plus positional correction counted as kinetic energy, violating elastic bound. Slowing the impactor removes it.
vision_note: Two circles drift close together over steps 23-25, with a small circle hovering just above and to the right of a larger circle. At step 26 the small circle moves down-left into grazing edge contact with the upper-right side of the larger circle.
